entities.name: UvrB (query sequence)
observations: 768-aa sequence containing one ambiguous X; physicochemical calculations were skipped because of the nonstandard residue.
Strong Swiss-Prot homology to bacterial UvrB: 66.6% identity, 77.2% query coverage, E-value 2.94e-279 (Bacteroides fragilis Q5LC24).

Likely ATP-dependent DNA damage recognition/translocase component of bacterial nucleotide-excision repair; reference annotation associates UvrB with UvrA during lesion search and UvrC in incision complex.
Pfam matches: UvrB_inter (305–394), UvrB_3rd (400–459), Helicase_C (579–690), UvrB (697–738); also Pep_deformylase (3–150) and ResIII (158–231), interpretations require caution.
